title: 2016 Panini Prizm #35 Earl Thomas Texas Longhorns Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2016 Panini Prizm Draft Picks trading card features Earl Thomas, a player from the Texas Longhorns team. The card is numbered 35 and is in excellent shape, near mint and mint conditions. It is a single card from the 2016 set and is a great addition to any football fan's collection. The card is manufactured by Panini and is part of the modern era of trading cards, from 1970 to now. This item is perfect for collectors and fans alike and is sure to be a cherished addition to any collection.
